module_summary: AXI4 safety bridge that double-buffers all five channels between upstream slave and downstream master ports, monitors downstream protocol violations and timeouts, and on fault disconnects the slave returning SLVERR.

anchors.name: o_write_fault
anchors.why: Sticky write-fault flag; blocks M_AXI_AWVALID, forces error B responses, resets write counters.

anchors.name: o_read_fault
anchors.why: Sticky read-fault flag; blocks M_AXI_ARVALID and makes read returns SLVERR.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: Upstream write-address valid; captures AW request into skid buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: Upstream read-address valid; loads AR buffer and outstanding read counter.

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: Registered downstream write-address valid, suppressed on write fault.

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: Registered downstream read-address valid, suppressed on read fault.

anchors.name: S_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: Upstream write data payload forwarded through W double buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: Registered upstream read data from slave or double buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWREADY
anchors.why: Write-address ready; drops after accept, reasserts after B handshake (one burst at a time).

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARREADY
anchors.why: Read-address ready; drops after accept, reasserts after last R beat.

anchors.name: S_AXI_WREADY
anchors.why: Write-data ready; idles low until AW accepted, stalls on downstream backpressure.

anchors.name: S_AXI_BVALID
anchors.why: Upstream write response valid, from slave or generated error response.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RVALID
anchors.why: Upstream read data valid from slave, double buffer or error path.

anchors.name: write_timer
anchors.why: Saturating write-response timeout timer feeding write_timeout.

anchors.name: read_timer
anchors.why: Saturating read-return timeout timer feeding read_timeout.

anchors.name: faulty_write_return
anchors.why: Combinational detector of illegal B returns (wrong ID, early, extra); sets write fault.

anchors.name: faulty_read_return
anchors.why: Combinational detector of illegal R returns (wrong ID, RLAST, EXOKAY); sets read fault.

anchors.name: rfifo_counter
anchors.why: Counts remaining read beats of outstanding burst; drives rfifo_last/empty.

anchors.name: m_wpending
anchors.why: Remaining downstream write beats; generates WLAST and empty status on fault.

anchors.name: r_wvalid
anchors.why: W skid-buffer occupied flag; selects buffered vs direct write data.

anchors.name: r_rvalid
anchors.why: R skid-buffer occupied flag; stalls M_AXI_RREADY, selects buffered read data.

anchors.name: write_timeout
anchors.why: Set when write_timer reaches OPT_TIMEOUT; forces o_write_fault.

anchors.name: read_timeout
anchors.why: Set when read_timer hits OPT_TIMEOUT; forces o_read_fault.

anchors.name: r_awvalid
anchors.why: AW double-buffer valid; selects stored vs incoming AW fields.

anchors.name: r_arvalid
anchors.why: AR double-buffer valid; selects stored vs incoming AR fields.

anchors.name: r_wdata
anchors.why: Skid-buffer copy of write data held while downstream stalls.

anchors.name: r_rdata
anchors.why: Skid-buffer copy of downstream read data while upstream stalls.

anchors.name: r_awaddr
anchors.why: Buffered write address with other r_aw* fields.

anchors.name: r_araddr
anchors.why: Buffered read address with other r_ar* fields.

anchors.name: M_AXI_WVALID
anchors.why: Registered downstream write-data valid from m_wvalid mux.

anchors.name: M_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: Registered downstream write data from double buffer mux.

anchors.name: M_AXI_BVALID
anchors.why: Downstream write response valid, checked for faults then forwarded.

anchors.name: M_AXI_RVALID
anchors.why: Downstream read valid, checked by faulty_read_return and forwarded.

anchors.name: M_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: Downstream read data captured into r_rdata or passed through.

anchors.name: M_AXI_RREADY
anchors.why: Downstream read ready, low while R double buffer is full.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWADDR
anchors.why: Upstream write address forwarded to M_AXI_AWADDR.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARADDR
anchors.why: Upstream read address forwarded to M_AXI_ARADDR.

anchors.name: s_wbursts
anchors.why: Outstanding upstream write-burst count (0/1); validates B returns, gates WREADY.

anchors.name: rfifo_empty
anchors.why: No outstanding read beats; clears read_timer, drives error-mode m_rvalid.

anchors.name: rfifo_last
anchors.why: Final read beat expected; checks RLAST and generates m_rlast.

anchors.name: m_wempty
anchors.why: No downstream write beats pending; validates B return, gates fault-mode WVALID.

anchors.name: exread
anchors.why: Tracks exclusive-read burst to detect EXOKAY/OKAY switching (OPT_EXCLUSIVE only).

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARESETN
anchors.why: Downstream reset output; mirrors upstream reset, or self-reset on fault if enabled.

anchors.name: clear_fault
anchors.why: Self-reset fault clear (tied 0 unless OPT_SELF_RESET); clears faults and timeouts.

anchors.name: lock_active
anchors.why: Per-ID exclusive lock tracking; zero when OPT_EXCLUSIVE disabled.

groups.name: Write address double buffer
groups.description: Skid buffer r_aw*/m_aw* forwarding upstream AW request to registered M_AXI_AW* outputs.

groups.name: Write data double buffer
groups.description: W skid buffer plus pending-beat counter generating WLAST/WVALID even under fault.

groups.name: Write response and fault monitor
groups.description: Checks B returns and timeouts, sets o_write_fault, then substitutes SLVERR responses.

groups.name: Read address double buffer
groups.description: Skid buffer r_ar*/m_ar* forwarding upstream AR request to registered M_AXI_AR* outputs.

groups.name: Read return fault monitor
groups.description: Tracks outstanding read beats, checks R returns and timeout, sets o_read_fault.

groups.name: Read data double buffer
groups.description: R skid buffer muxing slave data or SLVERR into registered S_AXI_R* outputs.

groups.name: Self-reset and exclusive lock
groups.description: Optional downstream self-reset/fault clearing and exclusive-access lock tracking (parameter gated).
